title: Enhanced hepatoprotective efficacy of quercetin nanoparticles versus free quercetin against acrylamide-induced hepatotoxicity through modulation of MAPK/NF-kappaB/NLRP3 signaling pathways and molecular docking validation.
authors: Atta, Rasha; Arafat, Horeya Erfan Korayem; Khalil, Islam A; Ali, Dina A; Abd El-Fadeal, Noha M; Kattan, Shahad W; Alelwani, Walla; Fawzy, Manal S; Mansour, Mona F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮素纳米颗粒对丙烯酰胺肝毒性的保护作用，分子对接仅用于验证小分子与炎症蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Acrylamide (ACR) is a hazardous contaminant posing significant hepatotoxic risks. This study investigates the hepatoprotective efficacy of quercetin-loaded nanoparticles compared to free quercetin in mitigating ACR-induced hepatotoxicity. Nanoparticles were formulated using nanoprecipitation with galactose-functionalized surfaces to enhance liver targeting. Rats were allocated into five groups: control, ACR-induced hepatotoxicity, blank nanoparticles, free quercetin, and quercetin nanoparticles. Hepatotoxicity was assessed through biochemical, molecular, histopathological, and immunohistochemical analyses, along with molecular docking studies. Results demonstrated significant elevations in hepatic enzyme levels (ALT, AST), oxidative stress markers (MDA), inflammatory mediators (MAPK, NF-kappaB1, NLRP3, IL-1beta, IL-6), and apoptotic factors (CASP3, BAX, P53), alongside reductions in antioxidant enzymes (GSH, GPx) in the ACR group. Both quercetin treatments effectively reduced these adverse effects, with quercetin nanoparticles exhibiting superior performance, evidenced by a 25 % greater reduction in oxidative markers and a 30 % increase in antioxidant enzyme activity. Molecular docking confirmed strong interactions between quercetin and key inflammatory pathway proteins (MAPK, NF-kappaB, NLRP3). Enhanced bioavailability and targeted delivery contributed to the nanoparticles' superior efficacy. These findings suggest that quercetin nanoparticles significantly outperform free quercetin in ameliorating ACR-induced hepatotoxicity by attenuating oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis, providing a robust foundation for their future clinical exploration..
abstract_zh: 丙烯酰胺（ACR）是一种具有显著肝毒性风险的危险污染物。本研究探讨了负载槲皮素的纳米颗粒与游离槲皮素相比，在缓解ACR诱导的肝毒性方面的保肝功效。采用纳米沉淀法制备了具有半乳糖功能化表面的纳米颗粒，以增强肝脏靶向性。大鼠被分为五组：对照组、ACR诱导肝毒性组、空白纳米颗粒组、游离槲皮素组和槲皮素纳米颗粒组。通过生化、分子、组织病理学和免疫组织化学分析以及分子对接研究评估肝毒性。结果表明，ACR组中肝酶水平（ALT、AST）、氧化应激标志物（MDA）、炎症介质（MAPK、NF-kappaB1、NLRP3、IL-1beta、IL-6）和凋亡因子（CASP3、BAX、P53）显著升高，同时抗氧化酶（GSH、GPx）水平降低。两种槲皮素治疗均有效减轻了这些不良效应，其中槲皮素纳米颗粒表现出更优性能，氧化标志物额外降低25%，抗氧化酶活性增加30%。分子对接证实槲皮素与关键炎症通路蛋白（MAPK、NF-kappaB、NLRP3）之间存在强相互作用。增强的生物利用度和靶向递送促进了纳米颗粒的优越功效。这些发现表明，槲皮素纳米颗粒在改善ACR诱导的肝毒性方面显著优于游离槲皮素，通过减轻氧化应激、炎症和凋亡发挥作用，为其未来的临床探索提供了坚实基础。
